how_to_use_markdown:
This Keyword returns the Last Traded Price of the selected Instrument. You can use it under condition builder to check the LTP of that particular instrument

![Example](./images/img-1632222763.png)

Note - To check the Spot index price, just select NFO, NIFTY 50. If you want to check futures price, select NFO,NIFTY 50, Current month expiry. Selecting current month expiry will return its future price

Refer to the below links for more clarity

Spot price - https://qna.tradetron.tech/t/how-to-select-nifty-bank-spot/622

Future price-  https://qna.tradetron.tech/t/how-to-select-nifty-futures/810/2

parameters.name: Instrument
parameters.description: Nested instrument reference: Instrument Name(...), Traded Instrument Name(...), or Futures(...). For Spot price use Instrument Name with an empty Expiry slot ('NFO,NIFTY 50,,,,,'); including 'Current Month' returns the Futures price instead (Rule 17).
